question: The base of a hemispherical bowl has a circumference of 132 cm. Find the capacity of the bowl. (use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Circumference of the base of a hemispherical bowl = 132 cm

**Concept Used:**

Volume of hemisphere = (2)/(3)pi r³

Circumference of the base of the hemisphere = 2pi r

**Calculation:**

⇒ Circumference of the base of hemisphere = 2pi r=132

⇒ 2times (22)/(7)times r = 132

⇒ r=(132times 7)/(44)=21 cm

⇒ So, the capacity of hemispherical bowl = (2)/(3)times (22)/(7)times 21times 21times 21

⇒ Capacity of hemispherical bowl = 44times 21times 21 = 19404 cm³

**Hence, the capacity of the bowl is 19404 cm³.**
